note: Treg memory / activation status on CCR7 × CD45RA, binary split (CM/EM/EMRA collapsed into a single 'Memory_Treg' bucket). Naive_Treg: resting naive Treg (Miyara Fraction I) — upper-right quadrant (CCR7+, CD45RA+). Memory_Treg: effector / activated Treg (Miyara Fractions II + III aggregated) — broad cluster across the other three quadrants.
tips: Treg memory / activation status (binary split). Naive_Treg: CCR7+ CD45RA+. Memory_Treg: all other CCR7/CD45RA quadrants aggregated. This step collapses CM/EM/EMRA into a single 'memory' bucket, unlike the 4-way split used for conventional CD4/CD8 (Steps 2 & 4). In-panel co-marker priors to formalize Miyara fractions (all in panel, not currently gated): Foxp3 intensity (low vs high) splits CD45RA- Memory_Treg into Fr II (Foxp3-high effector Treg) and Fr III (Foxp3-low non-suppressive); CD25 brightness reinforces Fr II.
